scope: Read-only diagnostics of existing full-source checkpoints; no retraining or model selection
rounds: initialization plus every saved state after rounds 1..30

source_evaluation.distribution: same source GMM; means (-0.5,1.5) on raw x1; variance .25 on x1 and 1 elsewhere; equal priors
source_evaluation.reuse: one independent set per dimension/seed shared across every arm and round
source_evaluation.uncertainty: per-sample Monte Carlo SE reported separately from across-seed sample SD
source_evaluation.baseline_identity: verify initial classifier log probabilities equal analytic source posterior to 1e-11

target_evaluation.data: the same archived 10000 synthetic evaluation samples and labels; no fresh target test claim
target_evaluation.nll_decomposition: sum within each cohort of current minus initial per-sample NLL, divided by total N; exact additive accounting, not a causal attribution

boundary.coordinates: original raw GMM coordinates, recovered through frozen source transform
boundary.nuisance: fixed independent standard Gaussian x2..xd; same probes for all arms and rounds of a seed
boundary.ray: vary raw x1; target Bayes threshold=0, source threshold=.5
boundary.root_policy: use only unique detected roots; keep missing, multiple and nonfinite counts and records
boundary.limitation: finite grid cannot certify global uniqueness or detect all tangencies/sub-grid crossings
boundary.normal: input gradient of f1-f0 in raw coordinates; ideal orientation +e1; parameter gradients disabled
metrics: RMS residual after affine fit as finite-probe nonplanarity
boundary.coverage: always report detected-root and normal validity; do not interpret missing roots as zero displacement

aggregation: all seed trajectories; mean and sample SD within dimension; paired population-minus-zero; rounds/probes are not independent seeds
github: runner, frozen plan, report, scalar tables, plots, audit and archive index; binary records local only
